name: Angelica
source:
An angelic girl, she discusses with her [url=https://vndb.org/c119574]twin[/url] and constantly questions about the future of the stars and what their fate will be. Everything about her existence is shrouded in complete mystery.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/12/30/kasutera/]official website[/url]]
